weapon_level_up: steps weapon id to its next level (its row's +0x46), its experience raised to the old row's step and its ammo filled (Going Commando's Weapon_LevelUp). A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.
weapon_buy_mega: the vendor's upgrade of item id to its Mega level (5): the level set, full ammo, experience cleared (Going Commando's Item_Upgrade). A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.

vendor_price: the price in bolts of the vendor's row under the cursor: the gun's +0x7C, or its level-5 row's for a Mega row, 9/10 of it with the discount (Going Commando's Vendor_Price). A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.
vendor_stock_add: lists item id for the vendor (vendor_stock 0x001D54D8, u16 per entry); item_give calls it. A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.

ammo_use: takes rounds of a gun's ammo (item -1: the one in hand), 1 when there were enough; always 1 for a gun without a maximum (Going Commando's Weapon_TakeAmmo, rac1's TakeAmmo). A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.
ammo_add: adds rounds to a gun's ammo, capped at its row's maximum (+0x8A), and returns what did not fit; ammo pickups and the vendor call it. A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.

give_level_items: a level's standing items at its start (the suit, the camera options, the thruster-pack), then the level's own; every level start calls it. A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.
hero_death_done: the hero's death over (state 57 ended, or a fall out of the level): the death counted and the respawn asked for (0x001A71D2). A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.

moby_killed: an enemy's death: the class's experience to the gun that killed it (its damage record), the hero's experience and its bolt drop (Bolt_SpawnPickups); Going Commando's Moby_RecordDeath. A hook point for mods; its instructions translated with none.

bolts_drop: a burst of bolt coins from a moby: an amount from low to high split into the biggest coins that fit (flag 8: at most maximum coins, the rest banked); enemies' drops (moby_killed) and the levels' scripted bursts (Going Commando's Bolt_SpawnPickups). A hook point for mods; its instructions translated with none.

bolt_coin_spawn: one bolt coin of a value at a position with a velocity, its moby or 0 (64 units or more from the camera the value is banked instead; Going Commando's Bolt_SpawnPickup). A hook point for mods; its instructions translated with none.

bolt_pickup_collect: a bolt coin collected: its value added to the player's bolts (0x00142660), the bolt HUD shown and its sparkle (Going Commando's Bolt_Collect). A hook point for mods; its instructions translated with none.

damage_queue: queues a damage record for a moby in the hit ring (0x001EED00, 64 entries); a moby keeps one pending (+0xA8), which a hit at least as strong replaces (Going Commando's Moby_PostHit). A hook point for mods; its instructions translated with none.

vendor_weapon_list: fills the vendor's weapons rows from its stock: rounds for each owned gun not full, the guns for sale, Mega rows in challenge mode (Going Commando's Vendor_BuildList). A hook point for mods; its instructions translated with none.
